extraction.Name: Barnett Shaw
extraction.NOTES: Document is heavily damaged and largely illegible; multiple questions and answers are unreadable. Allotment number 7157 and fee patent date 10/30/1918 are partially legible. Questions regarding mortgage, sale, taxes, cancellation, and dependents appear present but answers are illegible or missing. Postmark date JAN 30 1929 visible on envelope portion.
